description: This Java class manages the state for entity aggregation calculations within the Thingsboard platform, including interval management, result calculation, and debug tracking.

classes.name: EntityAggregationCalculatedFieldState
classes.description: Manages the state and calculation logic for entity aggregation, including interval handling, result computation, and debug tracking.

classes.name: EntityAggregationDebugArgumentsTracker
classes.description: Tracks processed intervals and arguments for debugging purposes.

classes.name: EntityAggregationDebugArguments
classes.description: Represents debug information for processed intervals and arguments.

classes.name: IntervalDebugArgument
classes.description: Data structure for interval debug details including start/end timestamps and updated arguments.

methods.name: setCtx
methods.description: Initializes context and configuration for the calculation state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the state, filling missing intervals if restored.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calculated field, ENTITY_AGGREGATION.

methods.name: performCalculation
methods.description: Performs the main calculation, returning future results based on current interval data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates argument values and ensures current interval exists.

methods.name: removeExpiredIntervals
methods.description: Removes intervals that are expired based on watermark.

methods.name: createIntervalIfNotExist
methods.description: Creates current interval if it does not exist.

methods.name: fillMissingIntervals
methods.description: Fills in missing intervals up to current time, considering watermark and interval boundaries.

methods.name: processInterval
methods.description: Processes each interval, handling expiration, activity, or intermediate results.

methods.name: handleExpiredInterval
methods.description: Handles intervals that have expired based on watermark.

methods.name: handleActiveInterval
methods.description: Handles active intervals, updating metrics as needed.

methods.name: processArgument
methods.description: Processes argument data within an interval, fetching metrics or using defaults.

methods.name: findMetrics
methods.description: Finds metrics associated with a given argument name.

methods.name: toResult
methods.description: Converts calculation results into JSON array format.

methods.name: getArgumentsJson
methods.description: Returns debug arguments as JSON, if available.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Indicates if the state is ready for calculation.
